marketBrief.headline: Fed holds on a split vote; hike odds for December climb
marketBrief.summary: The Fed kept rates unchanged 10-2, with two dissents favoring a hike. Stocks closed modestly higher, but the 10-year yield rose near 5.04% and futures price about 85% odds of a December increase.
bullets: Fed held its policy rate on a 10-2 vote; Hammack and Cook dissented for a hike (Yahoo Finance).
S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow closed up about 0.3%, 0.3% and 0.2% (Investopedia). Index levels not yet confirmed from a wire source.
10-year Treasury yield near 5.04%, up more than 4 bps on the day (Investopedia).
Futures imply about 85% odds of a quarter-point hike on Dec. 9 (Bloomberg data via Yahoo Finance).
Alphabet and Microsoft report after the close; options imply moves of roughly 5-6% (investinglive).
